description: European option pricing (Black-Scholes-Merton with continuous dividend yield): call and put prices, delta, gamma, vega, theta per day, rho, d1/d2 and probability of finishing in the money; with a market price it solves implied volatility. Works for equity, index and crypto options (set the yield to 0). Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/black-scholes

marketPrice.description: Option market price: solve implied volatility (needs type call or put)

volatilityPct.description: Annualised volatility in percent (not needed when solving implied vol)
